newsitem.title: USA: CBOE to list Morgan Stanley Multinational options.
newsitem.headline: CBOE to list Morgan Stanley Multinational options.

text.p: The Chicago Board Options Exchange will list cash-settled options on the Morgan Stanley Multinational Company Index beginning Wednesday, April 9.

The Morgan Stanley Multinational Company Index is a capitalization-weighted index comprising the stocks of 50 U.S.-listed companies that derive a substantial portion of their earnings from foreign income and have cash flows denominated in multiple currencies, the CBOE said.
The index was set on December 31, 1991 at 200 and closed at 426.49 on Tuesday.
CBOE will calculate and disseminate the index every 15 seconds throughout the trading day, the CBOE said.
